exposure: plasma fibrinogen levels (preoperative, end of surgery, 24 hours post-surgery)
cohort: The study included 169 term pregnant women who were candidates for an elective Cesarean section.
finding: Low plasma fibrinogen levels, younger age, and preoperative anemia were strongly associated with an increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage and severe postpartum hemorrhage in women undergoing elective Cesarean section.
cross-section timing: Before surgery, at the end of surgery, and 24 hours after surgery
